title: One Tuesday, Twice
description: Run a fictional 18-person service company through the same modeled day twice, then test how six workflow changes affect the outcome.
seoTitle: One Tuesday, Twice — An Interactive Workflow Diagnostic
seoDescription: An interactive workflow diagnostic that models one difficult day at a fictional service company, then reruns the same demand through a redesigned system.
problem: Service businesses outgrow their informal workflow long before they outgrow their headcount. The cost is hard to see because it hides in coordination: re-keying, chasing, forgetting, apologizing.
solution: A reader-first diagnostic with an optional simulation: experience the old workflow, add six changes one at a time, then compare both workflows under the same modeled demand.
result: A transparent, deterministic comparison that makes coordination costs discussable without presenting modeled outputs as measured client results.
